title: GitHub CLI logins
whyItMatters: The GitHub CLI writes an OAuth token for every signed-in GitHub account to hosts.yml in plain text. With that token a stranger can act as the person on GitHub, including reading private repositories.
source: GitHub CLI manual, environment: configuration is stored in hosts.yml under the gh folder in XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config: https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_help_environment
notes: Contains one entry per GitHub host with the username and oauth_token; GH_CONFIG_DIR can move it. The older ~/.config/gh/config.yml holds settings only and is not the credential file. A token is revocable from the GitHub account settings.
